We're a Nairobi-based digital agency built by people who know what it takes to ship products in Africa and refuse to settle for anything less.

Our Story

Started in 2022.
Built to last.

Tinyverse Solutions was founded on a simple frustration: East African businesses were getting overcharged for mediocre digital work or undersold on templated solutions that looked the same as everyone else's.

We built something different. A team of product managers, designers, and engineers who've worked inside real businesses fintech startups, health-tech platforms, NGOs where the product either works or people suffer real consequences. That experience sharpened us.

We work with founders and brands across East Africa who want digital work that's strategic and actually drives growth.

A message from our CEO

We built Tinyverse because East Africa deserves better digital work.

I spent years shipping products inside fintech and health-tech, watching teams build brilliant things with no digital presence to match. Great work was getting buried under bad websites and zero online strategy. Tinyverse exists to close that gap. We bring the same rigour you'd expect from a global product team, grounded in how Africa actually works.

What We Stand For

What we stand for.

01

Craft over speed

We don't rush pixels out the door. Every project gets deliberate attention from the first wireframe to the last line of code. Speed means nothing if the work falls apart in six months.

02

Honest by default

We tell clients what they need to hear, not what they want to hear. If an idea won't work, we say so early and come with an alternative that does.

03

Africa-first thinking

Mobile-first, M-Pesa ready, WhatsApp-native. We design for how Africa actually works.

04

Results, not deliverables

We measure success by what happens after we ship traffic, conversions, revenue, retention. A beautiful site that doesn't perform is a failure, full stop.

05

Partnerships, not projects

Our best work is repeat work. We're invested in your growth, not your invoice.

06

Own the outcome

When something goes wrong and it does we own it. No excuses, no blame-shifting. We fix it and make sure it doesn't happen again.
